about.title: A bit about me
about.intro: I'm Mariel,from Monterrey and a Computer Engineering graduate from ITAM. I currently work as a Software Engineer at J.P. Morgan and am also co-founder and developer at Guza & Larrondo Solutions.
about.guza: At Guza & Larrondo Solutions I'm a co-founder and software developer. We build custom technology solutions tailored to each client's needs, from design to deployment. I love that process of understanding a real problem and turning it into working code.
about.personal: When I'm not at the computer...

about.tech: I'm fascinated by how technology can simplify our lives. From productivity tools to augmented reality in industry.

projects.title: Projects
projects.guza_desc: I'm a co-founder and developer at Guza & Larrondo Solutions, building custom digital solutions for different clients. I love this kind of work because every project is a different problem to solve.
projects.tera_desc: Coordinated a team of four and drove the technological direction of TERA, an ITAM engineering lab that inspires children aged 8-12 with science, hands-on activities, and AR/VR experiences.
projects.plenna_desc: Developed a platform proposal for administrators and doctors of Plenna's Medical Clinic. Database with PostgreSQL, frontend with C# in Visual Studio.
projects.hackathon_desc: Developed a web tool prototype in a team of two as a solution to reduce the gender gap in companies.
projects.ftc_desc: Referee at the National FIRST Tech Challenge, in charge of penalties and scorekeeping.
